visual_review: Before was a flat-topped domestic-pig face with a big snout ring (box shape, no crest). Redrawn from the wild-pig reference silhouette: tall peaked crest between curled ears, round jowls; dot eyes and two nostril dots keep it a pig at 48. Valid, gate pass.
omissions: Snout ring omitted (head is 36 tall; a ring with nostrils cannot keep 8 from the jowl).
